help.faq_sizes_a: Prollagen is currently available in 500g and 1kg sizes, offering approximately 16 and 33 servings respectively.

help.faq_shipping_a: Free shipping applies to orders of ₹4,499 and above.
help.faq_cod_a: COD is available on eligible orders and serviceable locations. Eligibility is confirmed during checkout.
help.faq_returns_q: How do returns and refunds work?
help.faq_returns_a: Please contact support with your order number before returning anything. Final eligibility follows our published return and refund policy.
help.faq_accounts_a: Shopify customer accounts use secure passwordless verification. Your profile, addresses, orders and tracking details are managed through Shopify.

magazine.update_20260924_1: Wellness should never compromise on a life well lived.
magazine.update_20260924_2: Welcome to a space for better living, where science, skin and strength come together to find a balance
magazine.update_20260924_4: Strength is rarely about just one big moment. It is repetition, resilience, and restraint.
magazine.update_20260924_5: “Serqua” draws inspiration from the scorpion, a creature from unforgiving terrain of the desert, it survives, adapts, and remains remarkably equipped for its environment.
magazine.update_20260924_6: a body is built on consistency, and resilience is built through everything that asks you not to keep going.
magazine.update_20260924_11: The smallest movements can impact your emotional atmosphere, triggering neurochemicals to release.
magazine.update_20260924_12: Endorphins lift you, serotonin balances you, and dopamine motivates you.
magazine.update_20260924_13: Movement also increases blood flow, delivering more oxygen to the brain and body.
magazine.update_20260924_14: Even a short walk can shift your energy, focus, and sense of wellbeing.
magazine.update_20260924_15: Consistent movement regulates stress and supports a more resilient nervous system.
magazine.update_20260924_16: Movement is more than physical. It is a conversation between the body and the brain every move leaving an imprint.
